title: Mrunal Thakur's Birthday Celebrations Marred by Alleged Threats
summary: Actress Mrunal Thakur celebrated her 34th birthday on January 21, but the festivities were marred by alleged threats and a reported attempt on her life. According to reports, Salman Khan invited Thakur to his farm house, where she was allegedly offered a job. Thakur had previously expressed suicidal thoughts due to the pressure of her career. The incident has sparked concerns about the safety of celebrities in India.
